Grateful moves its connected pair beneath the ruff. The new lower clasp reads more as hands than an extra collar band at 160/240px. The offering mitten is farther from the ruff and rotated into a more open silhouette. It remains attached and small through the shown 1610–4100ms offer poses in both themes. The larger inspection sizes show an intentional hand instead of another cheek/ruff scallop.

Phone 320/390 comparisons show a less sideways head and elevated attention during 330–1900ms, compatible with the question above. At 2350ms the front-facing return is restored before the 2720ms offering hold. Desktop 1440 retains the appropriate lateral relationship.

Palette hierarchy, matte cream, pale marked forewings, greener hindwings and repaired antenna connections remain coherent. all-current.png preserves one tiny innocent character through the 24 held emotions; no added material complexity is necessary for these gains.
